rules.name: Flank March
rules.description: You may elect to bring on reinforcements from either of the flank board edges rather than your own table edge. Only squads from the Infantry section can deploy on the flank, and they must not have vehicles. Do not deploy within 15" of an objective. When you deploy your first units on the flank, your opponent must draw a BR counter.

rules.name: Desperate for Supplies
rules.description: Whenever you draw an 'Out of Ammunition' BR counter, roll a D6. On a 3+, play the counter on your opponent instead.
